limitations: Non-flaming pyrolysis smoke aerosol measurements only; O2 (21%) and pressure (101.3 kPa) are assumed ISS cabin conditions.

investigations.name: ACME – Burning Rate Emulator
limitations: PSI-20 CSV aggregates test days x listed O2 without per-flame pressures, flow rates, or extinction diameters.
Daily flame-count totals were expanded into parameter rows; cannot support per-flame events or independent-repeat counts without raw run binding.

investigations.name: ACME – Cool Flames Investigation with Gases
limitations: Inverse flames (CFI-G-I-*) report burner oxidizer-stream O2 mole fraction rather than ambient O2; must not be conflated with ambient oxygen limits.

investigations.name: ACME – Electric-Field Effects on Laminar Diffusion Flames
